email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Technical & E-commerce Support Analyst role at Viva.com in Belgium. With a technical background in web development and digital marketing, I have hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms, POS integrations, and troubleshooting technical issues.

In my current roles, I build and maintain WordPress and Shopify stores, manage product catalogues, and resolve technical problems for clients. I have worked with POS/ERP integrations for large retail chains like ŞOK Market and supported API-based solutions. I am fluent in English and have working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking), and I am confident using AI tools and code to streamline support processes.

I am eager to bring my problem-solving skills and customer-focused approach to Viva.com's Customer Operations team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Technical & E-commerce Support Analyst position at Viva.com. With a solid foundation in web development and digital marketing, I have developed a strong technical skill set and a passion for solving complex problems—qualities that align well with the requirements of this role.

In my freelance work, I design, build, and maintain websites on WordPress and Shopify, often troubleshooting issues related to plugins, integrations, and payment gateways. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and running technical audits to improve search health. At Episto, I manage CMS content for client sites, including e-commerce stores like harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com, where I handle product catalogues and ensure smooth functionality. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo, gaining exposure to large-scale retail systems and technical support processes.

My technical background includes front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and proficiency with AI tools and automation, which I use daily to streamline workflows. I am comfortable diagnosing software, hardware, and connectivity issues, and I have a basic understanding of APIs and payment gateway integrations. I am fluent in English and have working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking), and I am eager to further develop my language skills in a professional environment.

What draws me to Viva.com is its innovative approach to omnichannel payments and its dynamic ecosystem of tech partners. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a team that values continuous improvement and technology-driven solutions. I am confident that my problem-solving skills, customer-oriented mindset, and technical curiosity would make me a valuable asset to your Customer Operations team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Viva.com.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce) including store design, product catalogue management, and plugin troubleshooting.

• Built and optimized websites with WordPress/Elementor, implementing technical SEO, structured data, and API-based solutions.
• Front-end development background (AngularJS, JavaScript) and daily use of AI tools for automation and problem-solving.
• Fluent in English with working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking) and native Turkish.
